### Source

```text
# Adapted from ABOP-050, Anabaena catenula with heterocysts.
# Source: The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants, L-system 1.1 / Fig. 1.35.
# The final rule carries its printed complementary condition explicitly so
# this focused fixture has deterministic behavior under the default policy.

let CH = 900;
let CT = 0.4;
let ST = 3.9;

only F;

axiom Minus(90) F(0,0,CH) F(4,1,CH) F(0,0,CH);

match F(s,t,c) when t = 1 and s >= 6 then F(s / 3 * 2,2,c) f(1) F(s / 3,1,c);
match F(s,t,c) when t = 2 and s >= 6 then F(s / 3,2,c) f(1) F(s / 3 * 2,1,c);
match F(s,t,c) left F(_,_,k) right F(_,_,r)
    when s > ST or c > CT
    then F(s + 0.1,t,c + 0.25 * (k + r - 3 * c));
match F(s,t,c) left F(_,_,_) right F(_,_,_)
    when not (s > ST or c > CT)
    then F(0,0,CH) H(1);
match H(s) when s < 3 then H(s * 1.1);
```

## Binding-dependent weighted selection

Parameterized alternatives whose stochastic weights are evaluated separately for each predecessor module.

- Fixture: `cases/14-dynamic-weight.lsys`
- Features: dynamic-weights, parameterized-modules, weighted-productions
- Expected JSON: [`expected/14-dynamic-weight.ir.json`](expected/14-dynamic-weight.ir.json)
- Compatibility: CPU compatible; CUDA gpu-parameters, gpu-dynamic-weight; WGPU gpu-parameters, gpu-dynamic-weight

### Source

```text
# Binding-dependent weights exercise an IR feature that the current GPU
# backends intentionally reject during preflight.

axiom A(1) A(2);

match A(x) weight x then Low;
match A(x) weight 3 - x then High;
```
